releaseNotes:
🎙️ v1.8.8 Shared-Number Multi-Tenant AI Voice Receptionist Engine:
• 🌐 Single Phone Number Architecture: Shared primary Vapi number (+1 732-660-9121) dynamically serves every subscriber with their bespoke company name, trade prompt, first message, and calendar
• 📡 Instant Ring-Correlation Pulse: Android devices send a lightweight pulse on incoming ringing calls so the backend binds the incoming forwarded call directly to the user's account
• 🔄 SIP Diversion Header Carrier Support: Native telecom header extraction automatically identifies the forwarding contractor cell number
• 📱 Isolated Multi-Tenant Tool Execution: In-call 'send_sms' tools and post-call recovery texts dispatch exclusively from the specific subscriber's Android phone SIM
• 📊 Exact Account Metering: Call logs, duration minutes, and Stripe usage automatically route to each individual subscriber's dashboard
